newsitem.title: FRANCE: Scattered weekend showers forecast for France.
newsitem.headline: Scattered weekend showers forecast for France.

text.p: Scattered rains are expected in France over the weekend but will not be sufficient to bring much relief to thirsty crops following a three-month dry spell, the national meteorological service Meteo France said on Thursday.
"We are expecting scattered showers but they are unlikely to bring much relief," Meteo forecaster Franck Baraer told Reuters.
"We would need 15 days of rain to help improve the situation," he said.
On Friday light rain will hit western France from Caen to Toulouse. Scattered showers will reach the north and the southeast on Saturday.
"There is a chance of more substantial rain in the southern part of the country on Saturday," he said.
But by Sunday only eastern France will experience some rain.
On Thursday and Friday temperatures will be slightly above normal before returning on Saturday to seasonal levels of 15 degrees celsius for the north and 18-20 degrees for the south.
